findings: The real one-shot permission/approval/nonce/dispatch ledger boundary was incomplete.
Dry-run failures could hide the actionable terminal cause and protocol role.
Restart and legacy migration states could be ambiguous for exact-once runs.
Provider payload projection and route identity required exact protocol-specific binding.
Completion and durable commit failures required typed fail-closed receipts.
disposition: All findings received narrow production/test fixes before final review.
